security_audit.summary: All 41 static detections are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, documentation links, fixed workspace paths, and a public homepage URL. The skill provides a bounded email-list growth planning workflow, requires confirmation before saving, and warns that imported records are untrusted input. No prompt injection, credential handling, executable commands, or unauthorized data exfiltration was found.

remediation.suggestion: Use scanner-aware documentation conventions or configure the analyzer to ignore Markdown code fences, inline code, and relative links in SKILL.md files.

remediation.issue: The workflow references writing consent proposals and workspace memory files.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the existing confirmation requirement and fixed workspace destinations. Document that any helper accepts only approved operation types and validates destination paths.

content.user_title: Build a compliant email list-growth plan
content.value_statement: Growing an email list requires clear acquisition choices, consent controls, and realistic measures. This skill creates a structured strategy that connects these decisions without building or deploying signup experiences.
actual_capabilities: Defines acquisition channels based on the audience, offer, and stated growth goal.
Proposes lead magnets or signup incentives that match the planned email value.
Creates a single or double opt-in capture-flow specification with consent evidence requirements.
Designs referral or recommendation loop mechanics and quality safeguards.
Sets estimated or user-provided targets for growth, cost per opt-in, and confirmation rate.
Produces handoff guidance for consent registration and welcome-flow design.
limitations: Does not build signup pages, popups, forms, or confirmation emails.
Does not create legal advice or determine jurisdiction-specific legal obligations.
Does not access email platforms or analytics unless the user provides data through available tools.
Does not record consent or calculate proprietary benchmarks.

use_cases.title: Plan a new newsletter launch
use_cases.description: Define the offer, acquisition channels, opt-in flow, and initial growth measures before launch.

use_cases.title: Improve an existing signup funnel
use_cases.description: Review current list-growth inputs and create a prioritized plan for better acquisition quality.

use_cases.title: Design a compliant referral program
use_cases.description: Specify an incentive, sharing mechanism, attribution approach, and safeguards against low-quality signups.

prompt_templates.title: Start a list-growth plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan email-list growth for my audience of [audience]. My offer is [offer], and my goal is [goal] in [period].

prompt_templates.title: Create a lead magnet
prompt_templates.prompt: Design three honest lead magnet ideas for [audience] that support my email offer: [offer]. Explain the fit and expected tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Specify double opt-in
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a double opt-in capture-flow specification for [offer] in [jurisdiction]. Include consent evidence to capture and handoff requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Design a referral loop
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a referral loop for my newsletter. List size: [size]. Current signup source: [source]. Include attribution, incentive safeguards, and measurable targets.

output_examples.input: Plan growth for a weekly product-design newsletter targeting early-career designers.
output: Recommended channels: portfolio content, community partnerships, and a social profile signup link.
Lead magnet: a practical product-design review checklist.
Measure confirmed subscribers, cost per opt-in, and confirmation rate against the current trailing rate.

output_examples.input: Create an opt-in plan for an EU-based webinar series.
output: Use double opt-in and record signup timestamp, source, lawful basis, and consent wording.
Label legal guidance as general information and recommend qualified local counsel before launch.
Hand off consent-record requirements to the consent registry workflow.

best_practices: Provide the audience, offer, current signup source, and a measurable growth goal.
Use honest incentives that match the ongoing value of the email program.
Label estimates clearly and compare performance with your own historical data.
anti_patterns: Do not use misleading incentives or promise benefits the email program will not deliver.
Do not treat double opt-in as a universal legal requirement without checking the jurisdiction.
Do not invent baseline metrics or industry benchmarks when data is unavailable.

faq.question: Does this skill build my signup page?
faq.answer: No. It creates the strategy and capture-flow specification, not the signup experience.

faq.question: Can it write my confirmation email?
faq.answer: No. Use an email copy or sequence design workflow for confirmation email content.

faq.question: Does it provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It provides general compliance guidance and recommends qualified counsel for jurisdiction-specific requirements.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the audience, offer, current signup source, list size, growth history, goal, and jurisdiction when available.

faq.question: Can it set growth targets?
faq.answer: Yes. It can define estimated or user-provided targets for growth, cost per opt-in, and confirmation rate.

faq.question: Can it create a referral program?
faq.answer: Yes. It can design referral mechanics, incentives, attribution, and safeguards, while delegating monetization economics when needed.
